episodes.title: I Escaped The Cult Responsible For My Son’s Death
episodes.description:
This week Joe Santagato and Greg Dybec speak to a woman about why she joined a cult and how she was eventually able to escape. She also talks about why she believes the cult is responsible for her son’s death.

If you'd like to be on our show, we'd love to have you! Send an email to oplpodcast@gmail.com or visit www.oplshow.com we'll be in touch if your story is a fit for the show.
